input.ops: [{"kind":"replace","paragraphId":"p0035","oldText":"(a) EXCEPT WITH RESPECT TO CONTRACTOR'S OBLIGATIONS PURSUANT TO PARAGRAPH 9 HEREOF, CONTRACTOR'S MAXIMUM LIABILITY TO COMPANY ARISING FOR ANY REASON RELATING TO CONTRACTOR'S PERFORMANCE OF SERVICES UNDER A STATEMENT OF WORK SHALL BE LIMITED TO THE AMOUNT OF FEES PAID TO CONTRACTOR FOR THE PERFORMANCE OF SUCH SERVICES. COMPANYS' MAXIMUM LIABILITY TO CONTRACTOR FOR ANY REASON ARISING OUT OF THIS AGREEMENT SHALL BE LIMITED TO THE AMOUNT OF FEES PAID TO CONTRACTOR.","newText">(a) EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, EACH PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT EXCEED THE GREATER OF (I) THE FEES PAID OR PAYABLE BY COMPANY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM AND (II) ONE MILLION U.S. DOLLARS (USD 1,000,000). \"EXCLUDED CLAIMS\" MEANS A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY, DATA PROTECTION OR SECURITY OBLIGATIONS, ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILLFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD, AND ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS. COMPANY'S OBLIGATION TO PAY FEES DUE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT BE CONSIDERED DAMAGES SUBJECT TO THIS LIMITATION.
input.comment: [Playbook] We have made the cap mutual and set it at the greater of twelve (12) months' fees or USD 1,000,000, since a cap limited to fees paid for the particular Statement of Work is not a meaningful remedy for us. We have also added the standard carve-outs so that confidentiality, data protection/security, indemnification, gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sit outside the cap (the prior carve-out cross-referenced Paragraph 9, which is the independent contractor clause), and confirmed that our fee payments are not "damages" subject to the cap.
input.summary: Make the liability cap mutual at greater of 12 months' fees or USD 1,000,000 and add uncapped carve-outs.
